implemented: Added a stdlib-only, deterministic, disabled-by-default vector pipeline skeleton in backend/server.py with clear extension seams.
VectorEmbedder: abstract interface a future real embedding provider would implement (embed/embed_many).

DeterministicHashEmbedder(VectorEmbedder): offline, reproducible, tests-only embedder using signed feature hashing (SHA-256 -> bucket index + sign) over the existing _bm25_terms term space, accumulating term frequency and L2-normalizing; static cosine() helper. Captures lexical co-occurrence only, NOT semantics.
InProcessVectorIndex: brute-force in-memory cosine index (add/build/search) as the extension point for a future ANN index / external vector DB; nothing persists to disk.

VectorPipeline: wraps embedder+index behind an explicit enabled flag; metadata() returns honest JSON state (enabled/mode/reason, plus dim/min_score/is_real_embedding_model=false when enabled); rank_rows() returns a ranked list shaped exactly like _rank_channel output.

resolve_vector_pipeline(vector_config): maps None/False/{} -> disabled (default); True -> deterministic_local_test; dict{enabled,mode,dim,min_score} -> pipeline. Only mode 'deterministic_local_test' is registered in VECTOR_EMBEDDER_FACTORIES; any other mode (e.g. a hypothetical real provider) resolves to DISABLED with an honest reason, so no network/credential path is reachable.
_vector_config_from_param(raw): maps the optional HTTP ?vector= query param (1/true/yes/on/test/deterministic/deterministic_local_test) to the deterministic test config; anything else stays disabled.

Extended search_library(query, filters, limit, bm25_params, vector_config=None): default remains exactly lexical/BM25-only with result['vector']['enabled']==False and NO 'vector' channel (backward compatible). When enabled, a 'vector' channel is fused via the SAME existing RRF loop (no special-casing), contributing per-item channels['vector'] rank/score and 'vector_sim:<score>' / 'vector_mode:<mode>' hit_reasons; result['vector'] now reports vector_pipeline.metadata().

Extended evaluate_retrieval_cases(cases, k, bm25_params, vector_config=None) to thread vector_config through and report honest vector state (disabled by default, so eval-retrieval needs no embeddings).
Wired an opt-in ?vector= param into the GET /api/library/search HTTP handler (default disabled).

Added tests/test_vector_pipeline.py (focused new file) proving default-off backward compatibility and the deterministic enabled mode, offline/no-credentials, determinism, unknown-mode-stays-disabled, eval honesty, and the HTTP param helper.
Added tests/test_vector_pipeline.py to the py-compile gate file list in tools/run_quality_gates.py.

Updated README.md (capability row + known limitations), docs/ROADMAP.md (Stage 2B items/status), and docs/RETRIEVAL_EVALUATION.md (new skeleton section + boundary notes), clearly distinguishing this SKELETON from a real embedding model/vector DB/reranker.
not_implemented: No real embedding API/provider or local embedding model.
No credential or .env handling; the deterministic embedder reads no environment and never touches the network.
No persistent vector database (index is in-process and ephemeral).
No semantic entailment/NLI, no reranking model, no claim truth judgement.
No unrelated frontend UI changes (the existing search panel already renders result['vector'] state; it now shows mode/reason when enabled without markup changes).

risks: DeterministicHashEmbedder is signed feature hashing, not a semantic model; enabling the vector channel can rank by lexical co-occurrence in ways that look 'semantic' but are not. It is disabled by default and documented as a skeleton; the metadata sets is_real_embedding_model=false.

When enabled, result['channels'] gains a 'vector' key and items may carry channels['vector']; any downstream consumer that hard-codes the three-channel set should opt in explicitly. Default callers are unaffected.

The vector skeleton intentionally provides extension seams only; it does not establish production semantic retrieval quality until a real embedding provider, vector index, and real anonymized query suite are added.
